name: BreakBeat
description: Tempo-synced Amen-inspired breakbeat kit (synthetic voices, not a sample). Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. Syncopated kick/snare map; X grows ghosts and secondary snares; Y pushes break energy toward Fill. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill. Default ~174 BPM.

params.name: ENERGY
params.detail: Break energy, hats, and fill push
